name: Samosbor: Vosstanie
source:
This is an AVG with darker themes, crude art style and kinematic progression. The story resolves about folktale about infinite-spanning concrete building of unknown origin. 
Can you enjoy a tea while menacing presence is upon you? Immerse in animation-rich 5k word deepweb folklore as you traverse the script. Become culturally enriched today by engrish novelization of the underground russian Samozbor series!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/982100/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
这是一款主题较暗、艺术风格粗俗、运动进展的AVG。故事讲述了关于来历不明的无限跨度混凝土建筑的民间故事。
当威胁降临时，你能喝茶吗？当你浏览脚本时，沉浸在动画丰富的5k字深网民间传说中。今天通过俄罗斯地下萨莫兹堡系列的英语小说来丰富文化！

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/982100/]Steam[/url]]
